title: AI's Silence: The Hard Truths of User Expectations #shorts
description: When AI gives wrong answers, they stick fast. Imagine a cat finding a dead bird—they expect excitement! Denying it leads to upset. Don't crush user identity with "unreal" projects. #AIAnswers #UserExperience #TechMistakes #HumanNature
